title: The European Commission confirms a cyberattack that disrupted systems for 10+ days; CERT-EU says international hackers used AI penetration testing tool ARTEX (Gerardo Fortuna/Politico)
summary: Gerardo Fortuna / Politico: The European Commission confirms a cyberattack that disrupted systems for 10+ days; CERT-EU says international hackers used AI penetration testing tool ARTEX — Presented by European Commission's Directorate-General for Education, Youth, Sport and Culture — with MAX GRIERA — CIAO THERE.
contentText:
Gerardo Fortuna / Politico :

The European Commission confirms a cyberattack that disrupted systems for 10+ days; CERT-EU says international hackers used AI penetration testing tool ARTEX   —  Presented by European Commission's Directorate-General for Education, Youth, Sport and Culture  —  with MAX GRIERA  —  CIAO THERE.
